title: InstructionManifestLayer

layer.description: A layer of a run's standing instructions, in the order the text holds them: user (the orientation block, then owned instructions), team-bank, project, session, persona (a bot's), always-on (always-on skills).

characters.description: The characters the layer holds in the text: its parts, with the two line breaks between each two of them.

id.description: What the part is, within its layer: orientation for the orientation block, else the id of the thing it renders.

version.description: The version of what the part renders, where it has one (a catalogue entry's); null where it has none.

items.description: A part of a layer as the manifest names it: its id, its version, and its length in characters.

parts.description: The layer's parts, in the order the text holds them.

description: A layer of the composed text: which, the characters it holds there, and its parts.
